gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-electrolize: A marker-like line that never swells or thins gives Red Hat Display its signature, with daylight showing inside every curve. And Electrolize follows with a pliers-like open c and a lighter, plain sans touch, so the two feel modern together.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-elms-sans: Red Hat Display draws its bold, contemporary letters with a marker's constant-width line and visible daylight inside each curve. Elms Sans reads like a ballpoint, smooth and light.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-encode-sans: Encode Sans keeps its sans-serif letters distinct, with gaps that stop a c from collapsing into an o. Red Hat Display is the louder one, all marker-line boldness.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-encode-sans-ex: Neon-tube boldness, every stroke of Red Hat Display drawn at a single width. But Encode Sans Expanded is the one for steady reading, its sans-serif c shapes holding their tips well apart.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-encode-sans-sc: Red Hat Display runs on uninterrupted monoline strokes, so every curve shows daylight and every edge looks marker-drawn. Encode Sans SC settles in underneath with a shallow terminal curl and a wide gap, giving the sans a lighter touch against that bold heading.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-encode-sans-se: Encode Sans Semi Condensed opens its s wide, a modern and approachable sans sitting under a heading with a stencil brush's fixed line. Page after page, it stays easy on the eye.

Encode Sans Semi Expanded reads rounded and open, never cramped. Under Red Hat Display, whose curves and straights share a single width, a long run of sans-serif text goes down smoothly without any fuss.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-exo: Red Hat Display draws everything with one unshaded, constant stroke. Exo follows in a plain sans with wide gaps, so even a long stretch of text stays crisp and approachable.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-exo-2: Exo 2 brings a clean sans with plenty of daylight inside its curves. Red Hat Display, with zero stroke contrast, sets the bold tone, and Exo 2 carries the text under it without competing.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-fahkwang: Bold, marker-straight lettering, thanks to Red Hat Display and its direction-proof thickness. Fahkwang slips in beneath as a plain sans with a faint nib-pressure swing, its curves finishing before they close.
